latestVersion.changelog:
AI-generated video music lessons launched to make learning any instrument accessible to all.

- Generate music lesson videos for any instrument or skill, tailored to all experience levels.
- Covers beginner instrument basics, song tutorials, music theory, structured practice routines, and ensemble playing.
- Videos feature multiple camera angles, clear demonstrations, and patient pacing for maximized learning.
- Supports step-by-step skill progression and accessibility regardless of location or budget.
- Includes easy API integration for custom lesson video creation.
